text: Lost a 30 year old filling in an upper incisor so hopped in the car to here. Made an appointment for 2 days hence, arrived and was dealt with promptly. Very calm and professional, well equipped room and in less than 20 minutes left with an undetectable filling done without fuss or pain. Altogether a very pleasant experience.

1st visit: I had x-rays. No negative issues with the visit or the staff. Scheduled 2nd visit for a filling replacement the following day.
2nd visit: Another doctor asks ME why I am visiting today. He also cannot read the x-rays that another doctor took the previous day, i.e. he has no idea which tooth is an issue. After a few minutes of negotiation (I tell him which tooth) I proceed and filling is completed. I schedule filling #2 for the next day.
3rd visit: Another filling replacement with Dr. June. No issues. Very professional.
4th visit: Over a week later I schedule a root canal with Dr. June as I have pain in one of the before-mentioned teeth. When I arrive in the doctor's area Dr June is nowhere around and a new doctor asks ME why I am visiting today. THIS TIME it really shook me as this was for a root canal treatment. I calmly told him I would go to another dentist. When I arrived out in the lobby I heard him laughing with the assistant back in the working area. Very unprofessional behavior.
2 stars off for being unprepared and 1 star off for laughing so obviously about me or the incident.
Not recommended.
Solution: Respect your patients by being prepared with the information that is already in the system. Tone down the laughing.

I've had a similar experience with a female dentist there. She laughed at me for simply telling me to be gentle. She became very displeased and seemed emotional. I'm telling you, don't entrust your teeth or any risks to someone like that.

I was very unimpressed and surprised by this clinic.
The reception staff were unfriendly and seemed to be just going through the motions.
I called the clinic on June 28th, 2023, but was given an appointment for July 2nd, 2023. When I met the doctor, he said it was a difficult case and might take over an hour. He was in a hurry, which was confusing! What about me? I'll be back in Chiang Mai for less than three weeks, and then I have to wait six days for an appointment. This experience was very upsetting and a huge waste of time, as I have limited time and wanted to get it done before returning to my country. It made me realize I chose the wrong clinic! Is this even acceptable?! They should consider the needs of their clients when making appointments.
And why schedule an appointment for 11:15 AM?! Plus, a six-day wait!
In short, I only got a 600 baht X-ray (3 teeth). Luckily, the doctor didn't charge for the consultation, otherwise he probably would have!
I want to ask... are appointments at all clinics truly just consultations (as the doctor said)? This is the first time I've encountered such a waste of time!
I'm secretly thinking... is this acceptable?!?!

Almost forgot about the child, the child who used to be a crybaby. The tears of a man started to well up again. He peeled off his gums and dug up the tartar without stopping. He was dug by a sharp knife once more. Even the roots of his teeth were clean. The smell of blood filled his mouth. He spit out a mouthful of water. He could still see a little of it after 4 rounds. This time was the worst.

Awesome, just got out of the operating room. The doctor (Yutthakan) has a very light hand. I didn't even feel the anesthetic injection. The operation took less than 20 minutes, but it was very fast. I had my wisdom teeth removed for more …
The clinic was very kind, providing excellent care and advice, offering assistance, and not overcharging at all.
